system.description: When you encounter an NPC or Mob that is not immediately hostile or attacking, make an INT-Opposed Skill Check. On Success, the Mob approaches with wary curiosity.

upgrades.description: A Mob that is lower level than you won't attack your party unless they are attacked by a member of your party.
A Mob that is up to double your level won't attack your party unless they are attacked by you or an ally or your party is preventing them from completing their objective.
A group of Mobs of the same type up to double your level won't attack your party unless they are attacked by a member of your party, or your party is preventing them from completing their objective.

system.limitations: This Skill doesn't work on crawlers, Bosses, or Elites. You can only make a Skill Check against individuals, not groups.
